短语：turkish delight — n. 土耳其软糖（等于Turkish paste）
例句：Throughout the house, the views are a constant source of surprise and delight.
整个房子，目之所及不停带来惊奇和欣喜。

enlighten
音标：英 /ɪn'laɪt(ə)n; en-/  美 /ɪn'laɪtn/
v. 启发,启蒙,教导
例句：A few dedicated doctors have fought for years to enlighten the profession.
少数富有献身精神的医生为启蒙这一行业而奋斗多年。
